title: Announcing the finalists for the GSMArena 2026 End-of-Year Awards
description: 2026 brought us some incredible smartphones, tablets and other gadgets and we wanted to recognize the best of them – here are the GSMArena 2026 End-of-Year Awards Nominees. There are thirteen categories and the winners will be decided in the coming days. Our team of expert reviewers has tested over 200 devices over the past twelve months. We focused mainly on phones, but we will also be awarding the best tablet, smartwatch and smart accessory from this year. We have already decided on which devices get a nomination and are currently deliberating on the winners for each category. In the...

title: Samsung Galaxy Watch8 is now receiving the update to One UI 9 Watch based on Wear OS 7
description: Google unveiled Wear OS 7 in May, and then proceeded to roll it out to its Pixel Watches in June. Meanwhile, Samsung has been working on its own One UI 9 Watch, which is based on Wear OS 7, commencing a beta program for the Galaxy Watch8 in late August. [#InlinePriceWidget,13997,1#] Today, the Korean company has finally started rolling out the final update to One UI 9 Watch based on Wear OS 7 to the Galaxy Watch8. As has been the case with all new Samsung updates in the past few months, it's going out in Korea first, where it arrives over-the-air as version L320XXU2BZJ7, a roughly 2GB...

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max in for review
description: We got our hands on the latest Xiaomi 18 Pros, and we're unboxing both, starting with the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max. Here's the video unboxing over at our official TikTok. The global unit ships with a USB cable and a transparent case. Ours is the Velvet Red model with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. The provided case is a quality product. It's thick and should provide the needed reassurance that your phone is protected. The in-box case in the hand However, should you need more protection and an increase in quality, there's the official Xiaomi Silicone Magnetic case. It has a...

title: Samsung made limited edition Galaxy Buds4 Pro with Nina Chuba
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy Buds4 Pro back in February alongside the Galaxy S26 series smartphones, and now the company is coming out with a new special edition made in collaboration with pop star Nina Chuba. This version will be limited to just 2,000 units. The price is the same €249, so you don't have to pay more than the recommended retail price for the regular model. The special edition is already up for pre-order at Amazon Germany, and it will be released on November 10. If you're wondering what's different, the Nina Chuba Galaxy Buds4 Pro come in white and have a case with a...

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL vs. Pixel 10 Pro XL
description: The shopping season is upon us, and if you're considering a new Pixel, there's an interesting choice to make. The latest Google Pixel 11 Pro XL can now be found for around €1,100, while last year's Google Pixel 10 Pro XL is available for roughly €900. That's a premium of about €200 for the newer model at some online retailers, though the difference can be considerably larger elsewhere. So what exactly are you getting for the extra money, and is it worth paying? Let's find out. Table of Contents: Design Display Battery Life Charging Speaker Test Performance ...

title: Leak details Samsung's plans for Galaxy AI Premium: new features on free and paid tiers
description: Samsung organized its push into AI under the “Galaxy AI” umbrella, which includes a bunch of free features. There was always the understanding that at some point Samsung will start charging for some features. It just wasn’t clear which features or how much. The change was supposed to happen in 2025, but it didn’t. It didn’t happen this year either. There is still no official info, but a detailed leak by SamMobile finally brings some clarity to the situation. We’ll start with the good news – the currently available features are free and will remain free. Samsung will introduce new features...

title: iPhone 18 and 18e to feature same sized screens and batteries
description: The iPhone 18 is expected to enter its production phase later this month and we already knew that it would get a battery upgrade but we now have some specific numbers to look at. According to a new Weibo post from Fixed Focus Digital, the 18 (codenamed Taycan) is getting a 4,430 mAh cell. That’s a healthy 20% upgrade over the iPhone 17’s 3,692 mAh battery capacity. But that will apparently come at the cost of a physical SIM slot, which has been axed. Apple is also expected to implement a redesigned Taptic engine and a bottom-firing speaker. The same source specifies that the upcoming...

title: Here's your first look at Huawei's wide-screen phone from sub-brand Osta
description: According to recent rumors, Huawei is preparing to introduce a new sub-brand called Xingmang, or Osta in English. The brand's first smartphones are expected to include a wide-screen model dubbed the Osta S1 Pro. Well-known tipster Digital Chat Station has now shared an image showing the front of what appears to be the rumored Osta S1 Pro. While the tipster doesn't explicitly mention the phone's name, its wallpaper suggests that it is indeed the Osta device. The phone is shown in three color options, although its rear panel remains out of view. From the front, we can see a flat...

title: One UI 9.5 to make Bixby even smarter, capable of handling daily tasks
description: While One UI 10 is rumored to bring major UI and usability changes, the One UI 9.5 update shapes up to be a pretty major stepping stone itself. The latest report from SamMobile suggests that Samsung will bring some notable upgrades, specifically in the AI space. Bixby's new automated tasks According to the leak, Samsung is planning to make Bixby even smarter by turning it into a full-fledged AI assistant. Bixby will be capable of handling daily tasks for you in the background. Bixby will be able to report the exchange rate between USD and INR every morning as a recurring...

title: It's official: the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are launching globally next week
description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro series launched in China in late September. Since then, the company has dialed in the time frame for the global launch – initially, it only confirmed there will be a global launch and later it said that it will be in November. Now we have the exact date. The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will launch for the global market on November 17 (Tuesday next week) with an event in Paris. The event is scheduled for 13:00 UTC and promises “more surprises”. The Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max global launch will be in Paris on November 17 The event will be live streamed...

title: The Oppo Pad Air6 (aka Oppo Pad 6) unveiled, sales start next week
description: The Oppo Reno17 series is coming next week and instead of waiting until then, the company decided to reveal the new Oppo Pad Air6 today and launch it next week with the phones – in other words, we have the full specs sheet for the tablet, but we don’t know the pricing yet. This is a sequel to the Oppo Pad Air5, a tablet that launched globally as the “Oppo Pad 5”. We expect this new one to turn into the Pad 6 if and when it becomes available globally. Oppo Pad Air6/Oppo Pad 6 in: Starlight Silver Not much has changed in this iteration of the tablet. It still has a 12.1” LCD with...

title: Here's what vivo will probably call its first gimbal camera
description: We've long heard that both Oppo and vivo are working on their very own gimbal cameras meant to compete with DJI's Osmo Pocket line and Insta360's Luna family. Recently, a Chinese tipster claimed that Oppo's device is almost ready for the prime time, and now we have some news about vivo's offering too. The company has filed for a trademark for the vivo Pocket name, and in the filing it describes that it can be used for video cameras and gimbals, mounts that track moving subjects, waterproof cases, remote shutter releases, selfie sticks, monopods, and even thermal imaging cameras. So...

title: Honor 700 devices teased to come with an interesting feature on the rear screen
description: A few days ago, Honor officially revealed the design of the upcoming 700, 700 Pro, and 700S. All three phones will have a rear display inside the camera plateau, and interestingly, this screen will be able to show your heart rate and blood oxygen level. This has been inferred from the latest teaser image put out by the brand for the series, which shows the heart rate and blood oxygen level. That said, Honor hasn’t specifically confirmed this feature yet. That also means that we can't be sure how exactly it will work. Obviously, there needs to be a sensor on there somewhere, which...

title: The Oppo Reno17 and Reno17 Pro are launching next week
description: Last week, we reported that Oppo would unveil the Reno17 series today, but it turns out that it was incorrect. The company has now officially confirmed the lineup's launch date in China. Oppo’s Reno17 series will go official in China on November 16, the company confirmed in a Weibo post. The brand will also unveil the Oppo Watch 5 and the Oppo Pad Air 6. Alongside revealing the launch date, Oppo also shared the design and color options for the upcoming Reno17 and Reno17 Pro. Both phones are now also available for pre-order in the country, after blind reservations went live last...

title: Motorola Signature 27 is official, Honor Magic9 Pro Max at HQ, Week 45 in review
description: Motorola finally made the Signature 27 fully official this week, revealing a 7,000mAh silicon-carbon battery with 90W wired and 50W wireless charging. The flagship is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and features a 6.78-inch 120Hz tandem OLED display with up to 12,000 nits of peak brightness, alongside up to 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. The camera setup includes a 50MP main camera with Sony's Lytia 910 sensor and LOFIC technology, a 200MP 3x periscope telephoto, and a 50MP ultrawide. There's also a dedicated EVS action sensor designed to help capture fast-moving...

title: Inside ARRI: From Hollywood cinema cameras to the Honor Magic9 Pro Max
description: What does a $100,000 cinema camera have in common with a smartphone that's a hundred times cheaper? Honor recently invited us to California to answer that question by lifting the veil on the breadth and depth of its collaboration with renowned German camera manufacturer ARRI on the image science behind the Magic9 Pro Max. We had the rare opportunity to take a guided tour of ARRI's facility in Burbank, just outside Hollywood, exploring the company's heritage, its role in modern filmmaking, and some fascinating stories from its history. There was plenty to geek out over. The equipment...

title: Deals: Latest Samsung foldables, Pixel 11 series, and more discounted
description: This week, Samsung’s latest Galaxy Z foldables, the Galaxy S26 Ultra, and the Galaxy S26 FE are on sale on Amazon UK. They’re joined by the entire Pixel 11 series, including the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. Meanwhile, discounts are also available on the Motorola Razr 70, Apple’s iPhone 17, the Oppo Reno16 Pro, and the Xiaomi 17T series. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 and the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra are available with up to a £400 discount. Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Up to £400 off Read our review ...

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL vs Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
description: Looking for a premium Android flagship? The Google Pixel 11 Pro XL and Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra are two compelling options, but they take rather different approaches. Google's latest Pixel emphasizes its camera experience and tightly integrated Google software, while Samsung offers more powerful hardware, a broader feature set, and extras like Privacy Display and the S Pen. And due to the fact that the Galaxy is now the older model, it can now be found at a lower price. But does Samsung's hardware advantage translate into a better overall experience? And which phone comes out ahead in our...

title: Deals: vivo X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max come with freebies, the Oppo Find X10 series has a small discount
description: The quality of cameras has reached stunning heights – and so have the prices of said phones. AI-driven memory price increases are certainly to blame, but those 200MP sensors aren’t cheap either and there are a lot of them. The vivo X500 series went global at the end of October, led by the vivo X500 Pro Max. It has some of the best cameras (especially when it comes to video), check our review for more details. The Pro Max offers a 50MP main camera (1/1.28” Sony Lytia L910 LOFIC sensor), a 200MP telephoto (1/1.4” Samsung ISOCELL HP0) with a 3.5x/85mm lens and a 50MP ultra-wide (1/2.75”...

title: Weekly poll: are you interested in the Motorola Signature 27?
description: For a while there, it felt like Motorola had given up on flagships, at least the non-folding kind. The Motorola Signature 27 is a return to form for the storied smartphone maker (the phone’s shape is kind of reminiscent of the old Droid Razrs, isn’t it?). Among its many other impressive specs, this is the first Moto that supports GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused fork of Android that lets you decide how much Google you want in your life.
